steps.title: Gather cell culture reagents
steps.instruction: Collect the following cell‑culture reagents with the indicated catalog numbers: D‑MEM (high glucose, 045‑30285), Penicillin‑streptomycin‑L‑glutamine solution (×100, 161‑23201), 100 mmol L⁻¹ sodium pyruvate (190‑14881), 1 mol L⁻¹ HEPES buffer (17557‑94), Fetal bovine serum (174012), D‑PBS(‑) (043‑29791), 0.25 % Trypsin/EDTA (201‑18841).

steps.title: Gather additional reagents
steps.instruction: Collect the remaining chemicals with catalog numbers: Nocodazole (13857), Cycloheximide (14126), Biotin (029‑08713), Biliverdin (B386400), JetPrime (101000015), JetOptimus (101000006), G418 sulfate (078‑05961), Puromycin dihydrochloride (160‑23151).

steps.title: Obtain required plasmids
steps.instruction: Acquire the plasmids listed in Table 1 from Addgene (e.g., CT7‑LOVHook‑Zdk‑HT‑GPI #246600, CT7‑LOVHook‑Zdk‑NG‑GPI #246601, …, CMV‑TNFa‑Zdk‑Sca #246615). Also obtain the hook and cargo vectors: CMV‑hSec61β‑TagBFP2‑linker‑LOV2, CMV‑SP‑IPVNTT‑Zdk1‑GPI, pEB‑puro‑hSec61β‑TagBFP2‑linker‑LOV2, CT7‑cSec61β‑TagBFP2‑linker‑LOV2‑IRES2‑SP‑IPVNTT‑Zdk1‑FluorescentProtein‑cargo.

steps.title: Prepare cell culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix the following to make 545 mL of complete medium (Recipe 1): 500 mL D‑MEM (high glucose) (91 %), 25 mL fetal bovine serum (5 %), 5 mL Penicillin‑streptomycin‑L‑glutamine (1 %), 5 mL 100 mmol L⁻¹ sodium pyruvate (1 %), 10 mL 1 mol L⁻¹ HEPES buffer (2 %).

steps.title: Seed HeLa cells in 12‑well plate
steps.instruction: Plate HeLa cells (ATCC CCL‑2) into each well of a 12‑well plate with 1.5 mL of the prepared complete medium.

steps.title: Wash cells
steps.instruction: Wash the HeLa monolayer 2–3 times with D‑PBS(‑).

steps.title: Detach cells with trypsin
steps.instruction: Add enough 0.25 % Trypsin/EDTA to cover the cells and incubate at room temperature for 1 min.

steps.title: Resuspend and re‑plate cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the detached cells in complete medium containing antibiotics and transfer them into a fresh well. Culture for 1–2 days until ~80 % confluence is reached.

steps.title: Seed cells for transfection
steps.instruction: One day before transfection, seed cells onto a glass‑bottom dish or chamber slide at ~20 % confluence.

steps.title: Incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the seeded cells at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ overnight.

steps.title: Prepare transfection mixture
steps.instruction: In a sterile tube combine: 100 µL JetOptimus buffer, 600 ng total plasmid DNA (e.g., 300 ng RudLOV construct + 300 ng additional plasmid such as a Golgi marker), and 0.9–1.2 µL JetOptimus reagent (follow manufacturer’s recommendation for other reagents).

steps.title: Incubate transfection mix
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture briefly and let it stand at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: Add medium to mix and apply to cells
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL complete medium to the transfection mixture, mix by pipetting, and gently add the entire volume to the cells.

steps.title: Post‑transfection incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 6–18 h (do not exceed 24 h). Keep the cultures shaded from light after this point.

steps.title: Replace medium after transfection
steps.instruction: Remove the transfection medium and add fresh complete medium.

steps.title: Disperse Golgi with nocodazole
steps.instruction: Replace the cell medium with medium containing nocodazole (concentration as used in the lab) to inhibit microtubule polymerisation and disperse Golgi stacks.

steps.title: Incubate with nocodazole
steps.instruction: Incubate the nocodazole‑treated cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Warm up microscope
steps.instruction: Turn on the microscope and stage‑top incubator and allow them to equilibrate for ≥30 min before imaging.

steps.title: Place cells in stage‑top incubator
steps.instruction: Transfer the dish to the stage‑top incubator and insert a long‑pass filter SC52 in the transmitted‑light path to prevent unintended cargo release by ambient light.

steps.title: Set acquisition parameters
steps.instruction: Use excitation lasers with wavelengths >514 nm. For z‑stack acquisition, set a slice interval of 0.30 µm and collect 12–18 optical sections from the cell bottom.

steps.title: Adjust imaging settings
steps.instruction: Adjust detector gain and laser intensity so that Golgi puncta are clearly visible without saturation or bleaching.

steps.title: Define ROI and photo‑activate cargo
steps.instruction: Select the region of interest, then illuminate the entire cell with a 445 nm or 488 nm laser for ≥5 min (stimulation or scanning mode) to release cargo.

steps.title: Start time‑lapse imaging
steps.instruction: Begin time‑lapse acquisition according to the experimental design and save the data as .oib (FV3000) or .lif (STELLARIS) files.

steps.title: Deconvolve and convert .oib files
steps.instruction: Open .oib files in cellSens, perform maximum‑likelihood deconvolution, save the deconvolved .oib, export as OME‑Tiff, open in FLUOVIEW, export as .oif, then import the OME‑Tiff into Fiji via Bio‑Formats and save as .tiff.

steps.title: Deconvolve and convert .lif files
steps.instruction: Open .lif files in LAS‑X, apply Lightning deconvolution, save the processed .lif, open in Fiji and save as .tiff.

steps.title: Volume render and export images
steps.instruction: Launch Volocity, create a new library, import the .oif/.lif or .tif files, adjust colour and contrast, generate movies or still images, and export the results as OME‑Tiff or AVI files.
